inherited_scientific_fields.claim_scope: Existential local route/state responsibility within the exact frozen four-world development protocol and TOP1_SELECTED_LOCAL_NODE_CUT_V1 intervention family; no uniqueness, specificity, completeness, sufficiency, general-superiority, formal-confirmatory, or external-generalization claim.
inherited_scientific_fields.positive_phenomenon_floor: native baseline discriminator accuracy strictly greater than 1/3
inherited_scientific_fields.primary_endpoint: delta_accuracy = baseline_accuracy - cut_accuracy over the complete discriminator split
inherited_scientific_fields.secondary_endpoint: mean total-variation distance between paired baseline and cut 3-class probability vectors
inherited_scientific_fields.reduction_direction: comparator baseline accuracy >= native baseline accuracy and comparator delta_accuracy >= native delta_accuracy
inherited_scientific_fields.capacity_limit_rule: capacity-limited comparator mismatch is INCONCLUSIVE, never native mechanism support
inherited_scientific_fields.future_formal_surface_rule: fresh frozen untouched identity/evaluation surface unless prospectively valid adaptivity regime covers development exposure

intervention.target: selected[0] from deterministic unperturbed sorted top-k selection

validity_contract.route_selection: frozen and deterministic; baseline/cut selected IDs must match exactly
validity_contract.outputs: finite and single-valued with baseline/cut shape and dtype preserved
validity_contract.failure_disposition: INVALID_INTERVENTION, not a negative mechanism result

comparators.implementation: Separately trained SparseRoutingModel condition=dense_recurrent, seed 7602, four epochs, lr 0.012, fit split only, calibration split only, CPU; its own rank-1 target receives TOP1_SELECTED_LOCAL_NODE_CUT_V1.

comparators.current_route_tokens: native unperturbed rank-1 route id for baseline; CUT for paired intervention
comparators.fit_rows: each fit step contributes both baseline and paired-cut rows with the same target
comparators.state_advance: only the unperturbed baseline rank-1 route advances previous-token state; one-step cut is discarded
comparators.prediction: fit-count majority with lexical label tie-break
comparators.unseen_state: global fit-split target majority with the same lexical tie-break
comparators.calibration: cannot mutate counts, tie-break, fallback, or table semantics

comparators.event_encoder: detached frozen copy of the fitted native DEV-R2 event encoder; no comparator gradient may enter encoder parameters
comparators.episode_training: ledger reset each episode; zero_grad each episode; baseline fit trajectory only; mean episode loss; clip grad norm 2.0; one optimizer step per episode
comparators.cut_arm: exclude selected[0], force that ledger coordinate to zero for the current paired prediction, and discard cut ledger after measurement
comparators.calibration: IDENTITY_NO_TUNABLE_CALIBRATION; fixed conformance/finite-output diagnostics only; no weight, temperature, threshold, exclusion, or hyperparameter tuning

resource_privilege_contract.data: native and trainable comparators use identical fit/calibration episode identities; discriminator only after fresh authority and frozen implementation/analysis
resource_privilege_contract.labels: training/calibration labels symmetric; no future-step labels or evaluator motif identity at prediction time
resource_privilege_contract.runtime: CPU only; deterministic seeds and runtime settings recorded before any result-bearing dispatch
resource_privilege_contract.compute: native and trainable comparators receive four epochs and equal fit/calibration episode counts; extra comparator inference compute is allowed
resource_privilege_contract.intervention_privilege: all arms know baseline/cut; state-machine and eligibility comparators receive frozen native route IDs as specified
resource_privilege_contract.protected_data: no evidence/formal/sealed/freeze target, consumed identity, C04 manifest, or historical H7 result as tuning surface

forbidden: new comparator, metric, intervention, seed, split, privilege, claim, or falsifier semantics
implementation_only_cycle3.success_stop: STOP for fresh Evidence Analyst review even if implementation and ordinary CI are green
implementation_only_cycle3.ambiguity_stop: Any new science-affecting ambiguity requires another explicit versioned Analyst reassessment
